description: Create the DNS zone for a domain the authenticated customer already owns on AIvikings' own nameservers, so its DNS records can be managed here. Use it before adding records to an existing domain that should use AIvikings DNS, then point the domain to the returned nameservers with update_nameservers (which also creates the zone by itself). Safe to call again: an existing zone is kept. The new zone starts empty; records at the previous DNS provider are not copied, so ask the user which records the domain needs (for example its website A record and mail MX records).
name: create_dns_zone
